title: Replaceable elf 0.8 exec loader
summary: Replace production goblin parsing with a tx-owned ElfFileParser backed by elf 0.8.0, staged metadata reads, platform policy, and validated dynamic interpreter layout.

steps.title: Integrate bounded header, phdr and interpreter reads
steps.notes: Bounded header/phdr/interpreter reads are integrated. The 2026-07-17 final review required PageBacked EAGAIN to remain a typed Retry at every exec read boundary: the Phase-2 probe, staged image reader, and main/interpreter BSS tail reads now preserve EAGAIN while EIO remains EIO. Real file-backed PageContainer regressions cover the initial probe and a later BSS-tail page fault. Fresh Cargo verification is currently blocked in unrelated tx-reactor sources before tx-scripts compiles.

steps.title: Validate combined main/interpreter layout and auxv
steps.notes: Combined layout and auxv are closed: checked stack construction materializes NUL-terminated AT_PLATFORM from P::ARCH and original-path AT_EXECFN, preserves both across shebang/interpreter rewrites, enforces USER_TOP and 16-byte SP alignment, and retains vDSO AT_SYSINFO_EHDR.

steps.title: Remove goblin and close core host verification
steps.notes: elf 0.8.0 is the sole parser dependency; the migration-only goblin 0.10.5 backend, test, dev-dependency, and lockfile entries were removed after the differential check passed. Guest closure remains a separate pending step.

steps.title: Authorize exec against the resolved mount witness
verification: focused main and interpreter MS_NOEXEC and NOSUID authorization tests
steps.notes: Main and interpreter share execute-bit plus regular PageBacked candidate validation, retain the final namespace-resolved Mount, reject MS_NOEXEC after symlink/mount crossing, and apply NOSUID from the final alias mount.

steps.title: Make exec credential preparation transactional
steps.notes: Exec now owns a ProcessExecPrep bound to the authoritative ProcessIdentity payload key and lifecycle generation through Phase 7. Exec, exit, ordinary/last-thread exit, fatal teardown, and CLONE_THREAD share ProcessPayload.group_exit; per-TID linear permits and ExecAborting handoff prevent duplicate detach/count updates and release an abandoned collapse after the last in-flight permit. All production set*id and capset writers return EAGAIN while reserved. Checked AS replacement and credential commit validate the authoritative binding before mutation; stale payloads cannot mutate credentials or address space. NOSUID reserves without signing or replacing. Fatal AST/page-fault retries yield cooperatively, clone contention maps to EAGAIN, and timeout-bounded race tests cover both exec/exit orderings, clone admission, duplicate exit, and abort handoff.

steps.title: Prepare CLOEXEC closure before PoNR
steps.notes: Implementation now fallibly allocates and retains the complete exact-identity close plan plus the caller thread payload before sibling collapse. Final commit holds the authoritative payload plus fds/cloexec locks and rejects drift before the AS store. OOM, fd reuse rollback, success, and post-prepare allocation-fault tests are present. The step remains pending for two independent reasons: Cargo cannot reach the focused tests because of the unrelated tx-reactor timer/deadline split, and a last pipe/socketpair endpoint decrement or vfork/exit-source publication can still enter allocation-backed WaitSource/mailbox delivery after the AS store. Closure requires a prepared, bounded, non-expanding notification path in substrate/reactor.

steps.title: Add a generation-stable executable lease
verification: focused executable-write exclusion and ETXTBSY tests
steps.notes: Requires PageBacked ownership coordination; do not edit through the parser lane.

steps.title: Replace the one-shot EBUSY bridge with a yielding exec StepOp
steps.notes: The code shape preserves PageBacked/VFS YieldShape values and sys_execve calls the central Waiting driver. Phase-2 probe, staged reader, and BSS-tail read errors now preserve EAGAIN as Continue and EIO as EIO, with real PageContainer regressions present. Final closure remains pending until those regressions and shim integration rerun successfully; current verification is blocked before tx-scripts by the unrelated tx-reactor timer/deadline API split.

steps.title: Close GNU-stack NX enforcement with the vDSO layout
steps.notes: The VM builder now selects final stack protection once: explicit PT_GNU_STACK PF_X is RWX, mapped-vDSO plus no PF_X is RW, and no-vDSO targets retain RWX for the signal-frame trampoline fallback. Exec no longer overwrites PF_X with a post-map mprotect.
